meta.description: Senior software engineer building Go services, Kubernetes controllers and self-service platforms. Explore work at Gorilla Logic, Wind River and Kyndryl.

stack.q: Which platform technologies do you work with?
stack.a: Go, Kubernetes, GKE and GCP are central to my work. I build controllers and CRDs with Kubebuilder, manage delivery with Helm and Argo CD, and automate validation with GitHub Actions and Kind.

time.q: What kinds of platform problems do you solve?
time.a: My experience includes environment provisioning, self-service namespaces and application deployment, multi-tenant access controls, and secure CI/CD. I take capabilities from architecture through production deployment.

backend.q: How does backend engineering fit into your work?
backend.a: I develop Go services and REST and GraphQL APIs alongside platform capabilities. My work includes concurrent processing, dataloader reviews, and automated tests to improve reliability and maintainability.

fractional.q: Are you available for platform consulting?
fractional.a: I currently work full-time, so consulting availability is limited. I am open to discussing focused platform engineering and Go backend engagements.

timezone.q: How do you collaborate with engineering teams?
timezone.a: I work across engineering, QA, product and platform teams, supported by technical documentation, architecture reviews and knowledge sharing. I speak native Spanish and English at B2+ level.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.description: Quick answers about my process, timelines, and how we can work together.

time.a: Typically 10 business days for the first version, then iterating until you are satisfied with the result.

texts.q: Do I need to have the texts ready?
texts.a: Don't worry. I include a structure and copywriting guide. We work together to extract your value proposition and I give it a commercial form.

changes.q: What happens if I want to make changes later?
changes.a: If you need structural changes, design changes, or new sections after delivery, they will be quoted separately. The monthly maintenance ($20 USD) covers technical support so the site is always online and secure, but does not include development of new features.

hosting.q: Does it include hosting and domain?
hosting.a: The service includes hosting on high-speed servers. The domain (yourcompany.com) and any third-party paid tools (like Calendly Premium, Email Marketing, etc.) must be purchased by you; I advise you on the process, but payment is your responsibility.
